name: Asjon Dalipaj
headline: Software Engineer  ·  Enterprise platforms, integration and AI-assisted development
location: Utrecht, Netherlands  ·  open to Amsterdam, Berlin or London
summary: Ten years building production systems, eight of them on site at Rabobank as a consultant. I write the code and I answer the questions around it, from a product owner asking why a release slipped to a new developer trying to get their first change through. Most of my work sits between a backend that has collected nine years of business logic, the CI/CD pipeline that ships it, and the people who use it every day. I have been building with LLM APIs and agentic coding tools for a while now, and that is the work I want to do next, with customers in the room.

skills.label: Platform
items: WebRatio, model-driven development (primary tool, ten years)

bullets: Embedded consultant on a loan and lease contract system that around 70 people use daily. Nine years of business logic live in it, and the system is now in long-term maintenance.
Go-to person on the WebRatio side for both junior and senior developers.
Turn loosely written business requests into work we can scope and ship, and push back when a request would cost more than it returns.
Lead proof-of-concept work and present demos to stakeholders.
Represent the team in technical discussions across the tribe.
Own DevOps and the CI/CD pipeline for the team, from build and release to environment changes.
Integrate large third-party components over REST and SOAP.
Fix the critical production bugs, and profile the BPM framework to find where it slows users down.
Mentor junior developers, review their work, and help them land their first changes in a nine-year-old codebase.
Built finance web application pages and backend services with WebRatio, AngularJS and Java.
Wrote and tuned queries across PL/SQL, MySQL and SQL Server.
Streamlined a core process for roughly 20% efficiency gain.
Handled post-go-live support and bug fixing directly with the client at DLL Italy.
Built Java services for account management and frontend pages on WebRatio.
First point of contact for frontend changes and UI improvements.

projects.name: REA Bot
bullets: Scraper for rental listings across several real-estate sites, with a separate adapter per broker so a new source plugs in without touching the core.
An LLM API turns the scraped listings into structured records. They go into a database, come back out over REST, and land in a Telegram channel as they appear.

projects.name: JobHopper
bullets: Local-first job search: a CLI scans employer ATS boards (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Teamtailor, Recruitee, SmartRecruiters) and stores postings in SQLite.
Each posting is judged against my profile by an LLM, then published as a filterable static board on Cloudflare Pages behind access control, refreshed by a scheduled CI scan.

education.title: Secondary School Diploma in Information Technology
